title: test(plugin-security, cloud-connection): pin the hot-upgrade holder carry through install-local on a real kernel (#33238)
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DFWmDYdUPFhME7Z7Ky3ySCZ)_
Part of #33238

Area-lease pilot #33059, area A3.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只加测试与更正文字,不改运行逻辑。在真实内核上钉住"市场本地安装热升级 v1→v2、v2 把岗位改名"时,旧名任职人立即迁到新名、不需重启;对照岗位的任职人不动;同一个 v2 再装一次不写任何任职行。
- 为什么改:本卡剩下的第 1 个缺口(热升级时旧版本仍在服务)已因 objectql 的升级撤回旧条目(PR #33304)而在 `origin/main` 上实际关闭;本 PR 实测并钉死它,并更正仍写着"要等下次重启"的模块注释与尚未发布的变更说明。
- 风险与回滚:无运行行为变化;风险只在一条尚未发布的变更说明被改写(DELIBERATE CORRECTION,见下)。回滚即回退本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-hot-resync.test.ts` 末尾新 describe(真实门 + 真实 SecurityPlugin);`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.test.ts` 中收紧的热升级用例;`.changeset/33238-position-rename-hot-install.md` 的改写段。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/marketplace-install-local-hot-resync.test.ts`,预期 6/6 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。本卡在 A5 区的运行时安装/启用宣告卡(#33302)落地后即可关闭。

## What changes

Tests and prose only; no runtime behaviour changes.

- **Measured on `origin/main` (ba35dfd7):** gap 1 of the hand-over (a hot upgrade over a version the running kernel still serves) is closed. The re-register withdraws the position v2 no longer ships (`SchemaRegistry.replacingPackageBody`, landed in #33304), so when install-local announces `metadata:reloaded` with `app/ID`, the old name is no current position and plugin-security's reload run carries its holders. Both pins below passed on the unchanged tree.
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-hot-resync.test.ts`: new top-level describe, end to end through the real install-local door. It boots a real `ObjectKernel` with a SQL driver, `ObjectQLPlugin` and `SecurityPlugin`, and gives the door's `trigger` a real plugin context, so the announcement reaches the kernel's hook bus. Install v1, seed holders, install v2 (which renames `hotrename_sales_rep` to `hotrename_crm_sales_rep` with `renamedFrom`), and the pin checks three things. The holder moves at once. The CONTROL holder on `hotrename_auditor` is untouched. A second identical v2 install makes zero `sys_user_position` updates.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.test.ts`: the case "a hot upgrade over v1, which the running kernel still serves" accepted either outcome ("no holder is left on a position the catalog does not serve"). It now asserts that v1's position is withdrawn and the holder holds the new name at once, that the CONTROL is untouched, and that a second identical upgrade writes no holder row and says nothing.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.ts`: module doc ("When it runs") only. It no longer lists a hot upgrade over a served version as carried at the next boot. The runtime install and enable routes are still listed there.
- `.changeset/33238-position-rename-hot-install.md`: **DELIBERATE CORRECTION** of a pending release note (`check-empty-changeset` stays red on purpose). The bullet "a hot upgrade over a version the running kernel still serves: its old position keeps serving until the restart, so its holders keep it until then" is removed from "Still carried at the next restart". The install-local bullet under "Carried at once" now reads: "a hot install or upgrade through the marketplace install-local door (`/marketplace/install-local`), for the positions of the package it names (`app/ID`). An upgrade over a version the running kernel still serves is carried too: re-registering the package withdraws the position its new version no longer ships (`@objectstack/objectql`, #33050), so the old name is no position the kernel serves when the announcement is heard;". Restoring the base text would publish a sentence that is now false.

**What keeps #33238 open:** gap 2, the runtime `POST /packages` install and package enable routes not announcing `metadata:reloaded`. That is #33302, held by area A5 (branch `claude/area-A5-33302`). This PR does not touch `packages/runtime/**`. The card can close once that lands.

## Why

The hand-over (comment 6881180984) left the card open on two gaps, with gap 1 expected to need only a pin once dropped items were withdrawn on upgrade. This PR measures that, pins it on a real kernel through the real door, and corrects the two texts that still describe the old behaviour.

## Tests

- New and tightened pins: both green on the base tree with no source change.
- Ablation, both legs through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob changed, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty). Both suites alias `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/plugin-security` to `src/`, so no rebuild was needed between legs.
  - (A) `registry.ts`: the line `this.withdrawPackageBodyItemsNotShipped(packageId, previous, body.written);` was replaced. Both new pins went red. plugin-security: `expected [ 'platform_admin', 'org_owner', …(8) ] to not include 'hot_sales_rep'`. cloud-connection: `expected [ 'hotrename_auditor', …(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'hotrename_auditor', …(1) ]`.
  - (B) `security-plugin-start-hooks.ts`: the line `await positionRenameCarry.afterReload(payload);` was replaced. Both went red on the holder assertion: `expected { h1: 'hot_sales_rep', …(1) } to deeply equal { h1: 'hot_crm_sales_rep', …(1) }`, and the same for `hotrename_*`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Package suites and typecheck (full suites at ee6585a1; head d742709d changes only the cloud-connection test's import, re-run there: 6/6 and typecheck exit 0)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: Test Files 267 passed (267), Tests 6653 passed, 45 skipped (6698). `typecheck` exit 0, including `check:test-typecheck` OK.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection test`: Test Files 80 passed (80), Tests 1210 passed (1210). `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json`) exit 0. Both touched test files are in their package's test tsconfig (`--listFiles`: 1 hit each).
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the three touched `.ts` files: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 64 families)</summary>

- 59 families exit 0.
- `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`: exit 1. This is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION above, declared and expected red.
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: exit 3 on the shallow clone, then exit 0 after deepening.
- `check:test-source-alias`: exit 1. The first version imported `@objectstack/platform-objects/identity`, which is not aliased. It now imports the aliased root and the gate exits 0.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (no full-repo `dist/`). NOT MEASURED locally. The diff touches neither area, and CI runs them on a full build.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 64 derived, 64 run.
</details>

- The repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the dependents' test sweep are left to CI (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `Test Core`). No published surface changes: the only source change is a module comment.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on touched files locally; the repo-wide run is CI's)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
